deeper.title: What the price assumes
deeper.text: The price assumes about 9% a year growth in free cash flow for 10 years, then 3% (discount rate 10.0% = 10-year Treasury 5.0% + 5%; base: last 12 months of free cash flow). For comparison, sales grew 22% last year; 22%/yr over 3 years — the market expects a slowdown from its recent pace.

deeper.title: Return on capital
deeper.text: 7% — each $100 invested in the business (debt + equity, net of cash) earns about $7 a year after tax; return on shareholders' equity 11% (3 years ago 22%).

deeper.title: Signed future revenue
deeper.text: Signed but not yet delivered (remaining performance obligations): $29.7B, up 22% from a year ago — about 1.9× the last 12 months of sales; customer prepayments not yet earned (deferred revenue): $7.7B, up 20% from a year ago.

deeper.title: Earnings-quality red flags
flags: Receivables (money customers still owe) up 44% vs quarterly sales up 21% (days to collect 41 → 49). Customers may be paying more slowly, or sales were pulled forward.
Stock-based pay is 15% of sales — a real cost to shareholders that cash-flow figures leave out.

deeper.title: Multi-year view
deeper.text: Sales grew 22%/yr over 3 years and 23%/yr over 5 years; operating margin today 10% vs a 5-year range of 3–14% (median 10%): in the middle of its range.
deeper.margin_position: in the middle of its range

deeper.title: Cash returned to shareholders
deeper.text: Returned $2.8B to shareholders over the last 12 months ($2.8B buybacks + $0M dividends) = 2.7% of the company's market value. Share count down 0.4% from a year ago (about flat).

deeper.title: Analyst estimates
deeper.text: Next year's earnings-per-share estimate $4.80, down 4% in 90 days (down 4% in the last 30); 6 analysts raised, 32 cut in 30 days. This year's earnings-per-share estimate $3.95, down 3% in 90 days (down 3% in the last 30); 4 analysts raised, 35 cut in 30 days. Source: Yahoo (unofficial).

deeper.title: Where sales come from
deeper.text: By product, latest quarter vs a year earlier: Subscription 97% of sales, up 21%; Professional services and other 3% of sales, up 9%. Source: 10-Q XBRL.

tiles.title: Earnings per share
tiles.sub: +4% vs a year ago · $1.39 over 12 months (GAAP)
tiles.read: Profit per share grew 4% vs sales 21% (latest quarter vs a year earlier): costs are rising faster than sales, squeezing margins.
tiles.explain: EPS = profit divided by the number of shares. The quarterly figures are the 'adjusted' EPS analysts track (Yahoo); the 12-month figure is the official GAAP number from SEC filings.

tiles.title: Earnings vs forecasts
tiles.sub: last 8 reports · bars = EPS beat (+) or miss (−) vs the average forecast
tiles.read: Missed forecasts last quarter by 2%; another miss would suggest the business is weaker than expected.
tiles.explain: A 'beat' means reported EPS came in above the average analyst forecast. Source: Yahoo (unofficial).

tiles.title: Sales growth
tiles.sub: latest quarter +21% vs a year earlier · 12-month sales $15.4B
tiles.read: Latest quarter: sales up 21% vs a year earlier, about as fast as two quarters ago (22%): steady demand.
tiles.explain: Headline: sales over the last 12 months vs the 12 months before. Bars: each quarter's sales vs the same quarter a year earlier.

tiles.title: Profit margins
tiles.read: Each $100 of sales leaves $10 of operating profit, down from $14 a year ago: profitability is slipping.
tiles.explain: Operating margin = operating profit ÷ sales. Gross margin = what's left after the direct cost of the product.

tiles.title: Free cash flow
tiles.read: It turned 329% of its reported profit into spare cash: the profits are real money, not just accounting.
tiles.explain: Free cash flow = cash from operations minus spending on equipment and buildings: money the company could return or reinvest.

tiles.title: Price vs profits (P/E)
tiles.read: You pay 72× last year's profit (lower than 87% of the last 5 years); only 21× next year's forecast, so the market expects profits to jump.
tiles.explain: P/E = share price ÷ earnings per share. Forward P/E uses next year's forecast earnings.

tiles.title: Next earnings
tiles.read: Reports Jan 27; analysts expect EPS of $1.07, up 17% from a year ago. It usually moves about 11% the day after, so expect a swing.
tiles.explain: Consensus = the average analyst forecast (Yahoo, unofficial). The typical move is the average size of the stock's next-day move after its last reports, not an options-implied figure.

tiles.title: Company outlook

tiles.explain: Guidance = what management says it expects for the next quarter or year, from its 8-K earnings release.
